summary: Petition under Section 17(3) and 17(4) of the Electricity Act, 2003 for creation of security interest over all the movable and immovable assets of the Petitioner in favour of Catalyst Trusteeship Limited, Respondent No. 2 for the benefit of the lender, Respondent No. 3. 2. The Petitioner has filed the present Petition for approval for the creation of the security interest over the Petitioner’s assets, including all movable and immovable assets, in favour of Respondent No. 2, Catalyst Trusteeship Limited (“Catalyst”/ “Security Trustee”) and for the benefit of Respondent No.3, Power Finance Corporation Limited (“PFC”/ “Lender”) including its successors, transferees, novatees and assigns for a sum of Rs. 3,455,43,00,000/- (Rupees Three Thousand Four Hundred Fifty-Five Crore and Forty-Three Lakh only). The Petitioner has made the following prayers: _(b) approve the creation of the security interest by the Petitioner by way of hypothecation/ mortgage/ charge/ pledge/ assignment (as applicable) over the Petitioner’s Assets to the extent described in this Petition, to secure the total commitment to the Lenders aggregating to INR 3455,43,00,000/- (Rupees Three Thousand Four Hundred Fifty- Five Crore and Forty-Three Lakhs only), in favour of Catalyst Trusteeship Limited, Respondent No. 2 for the benefit of the Lender;_ _(c) approve the creation of the security interest by the Petitioner by way of hypothecation/ mortgage/ charge/ pledge/ assignment (as applicable) over the Petitioner’s Assets to the extent described in this Petition, to secure the total commitment to the Lender aggregating to INR 3455,43,00,000/- (Rupees Three Thousand Four Hundred Fifty- Five Crore and Forty-Three Lakhs only), in favour of Respondent No. 2 for the benefit of the Lender and for its successors,_ _(e) pass any such other relief as the Commission deems fit and appropriate in the facts and circumstances of the case.”_ (b) The Petitioner, for the purpose of part financing the Project, availed a Rupee Term Loan amounting to Rs. 3455,43,00,000/- from the lender, namely Power Finance Corporation Limited (PFCL), as per the terms and conditions stipulated in the Sanction Letter dated 18.6.2025 and the Facility Agreement dated 23.6.2025. Further, the Petitioner, Catalyst Trusteeship Limited and PFCIL entered into a Tripartite Security Trustee Agreement dated 23.6.2025 wherein Catalyst Trusteeship Limited is acting as a Security Trustee for the 4. The Petitioner has submitted that pursuant to the terms of the Facility Agreement, the secured obligations of the Petitioner shall be secured by the following security package: _b) the right, title, interest, benefits, claims and demands of the Borrower in, to and under all the Clearances (and shall include amendments or modifications to such Clearances, if any);_ _d) all the rights, titles, interests, benefits, claims and demands whatsoever of the Borrower under all Insurance Contracts (and shall include amendments or modifications to such Insurance Contracts, if any) and Insurance Proceeds;_ the Petitioner may create any encumbrance over all or part of its receivables or its 6. Accordingly, the Petitioner has filed the present Petition under Sections 17(3) and 17(4) of the Act, read with Article 15.2 of the TSA, seeking prior approval of the Commission for the creation of a Security Interest over the assets including the movable and immovable assets for the Project in favour of the Security Trustee for the benefit of the lender and for its subsequent transferees, assignees, novatees thereof by way of hypothecation/ assignment/ mortgage to secure the total commitment of the lender aggregating to Rs. 3455,43,00,000/- 7. The Petition was called out for the hearing on 25.11.2025 after notice to the Respondents. _Vide_ Record of Proceedings (hereinafter referred to as “RoP”) for the hearing dated 25.11.2025, the Respondents were granted the opportunity to file their respective replies. 8. During the course of the hearing, the learned counsel for the Petitioner submitted that no reply has been filed by the Respondents despite notice. Considering the submissions of the Petitioner, the matter was reserved for order. 9. We have considered the submissions made by the Petitioner and perused the documents placed on record. The Petitioner approached the lender, PFCIL for part financing the Petitioner’s Project and availed a Rupee Term Loan amounting to Rs. 3,455,43,00,000/- as per the terms and conditions stipulated in the Sanction letter dated 18.6.2025 and executed a Facility Agreement with PFCIL on 23.6.2025. Further, the Petitioner, Catalyst Trusteeship Limited, and PFCIL entered into a Tripartite Security - _i. the Lenders or the Lenders' Representative on their behalf shall have entered into the Financing Agreements and agreed in writing to the provisions of this Agreement; and_ _“17. (3) No licensee shall any time assign his licence or transfer his utility, or any part hereof, by sale, lease, exchange or otherwise without the prior approval of the Appropriate Commission._ _(4) Any agreement relating to any transaction specified in sub-section (1) or sub-section (3), unless made with the prior approval of the Appropriate Commission, shall be void.”_ of sale, lease, exchange or otherwise and entering into an agreement relating to any of these transactions. 15. Accordingly, we accord approval allowing the Petitioner to create a security interest in favour of the Security Trustee, namely, Catalyst Trusteeship Limited by way of mortgage or any other security document on project assets by execution of an indenture of Mortgage and financing documents of the Project. The Petitioner is directed to submit a signed copy of the Indenture of Mortgage for the Project immediately after its execution.
